sections.text_helper: Section 70.2 "MDIOS main features" in chapter 70 (Management data input/output (MDIOS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3603.
sections.section_content:
The MDIOS includes the following features:
• 32 MDIOS register addresses, each of which is managed using separate input and
output data registers:
– 32x16-bit firmware read/write, MDIOS read-only output data registers
– 32x16-bit firmware read-only, MDIOS write-only input data registers
• Configurable slave (port) address
• Independently maskable interrupts/events:
– MDIOS register write
– MDIOS register read
– MDIOS protocol error
• Able to operate in and wake up from Stop mode
